lab/desktop-mobile-real.purpose: Persistent real desktop and mobile client integration laboratory

rules: Cleanup jobs and scripts must never delete these branches.
Do not force-update these branches as part of generic cleanup or publication.
At the end of a repair cycle, update each branch only to the commit verified on its corresponding real client and record that SHA here.
Do not treat temporary tmp-* or disposable lab branches as replacements for these permanent branches.
